company_description:
Quillstone Payments is a privately held financial-services company founded in 2013 and headquartered in Hamburg. It builds payment and money-management tools for small merchants, including payment terminals, a point-of-sale app and a business account; it has also introduced a personal account for merchants’ customers. The company serves millions of merchants across Europe and the Americas and employs around 2,500 people across roughly 20 offices. Its teams in product, engineering and operations also work on customer-support automation and fraud detection.

Quillstone’s culture emphasizes team autonomy, ownership and practical problem-solving. Teams own their services and are trusted to decide how best to address merchants’ needs, guided by shared principles rather than heavy processes. The company values putting the team first, humility, candid feedback, open sharing of context and learning from mistakes. It is office-first, with some flexible days agreed by teams, and promotes ongoing development through training budgets, peer feedback, internal tech talks and twice-yearly development-plan reviews. Quillstone also supports local business education projects and publishes an annual inclusion report.

results.title: Careers at Quillstone | Our culture
results.content:
Our culture
We trust our teams: each team owns its services and decides how to solve merchants' problems. We value pragmatism, humility and candid feedback, and we expect people to share context openly.
We work office-first
Quillstone is an office-first company: we believe working side by side most days helps us build better products for merchants, learn from each other faster and enjoy the work more. Teams agree a few flexible days, but the office is the default.
Our values
Take ownership - act like an owner of the outcome.
Team first - optimise for the team, not for yourself.
Learn from mistakes - we say what went wrong and improve together.
Learning culture: training budget, regular peer feedback and internal tech talks.
